format: Markdown (with embedded code snippets and documentation)
description: Documentation for the FrameLocator class in Playwright, detailing its methods, usage, and behavior in various programming languages. The file provides API references, method descriptions, parameters, and usage examples for locating and interacting with iframes in automated browser testing.

classes.name: FrameLocator
classes.description: Represents a view to an iframe in a web page. Provides methods to locate elements within the iframe, navigate between frames, and convert between locators and frame locators.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a locator to the first matching frame. Deprecated; use Locator.first() followed by contentFrame().

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a locator to the last matching frame. Deprecated; use Locator.last() followed by contentFrame().

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a nested FrameLocator within the current frame, allowing for chaining and locating elements inside nested iframes.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Locates elements by their alt text attribute within the frame.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Locates elements by their label text within the frame.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Locates elements by their placeholder attribute within the frame.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Locates elements by ARIA role within the frame.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Locates elements by their data-testid attribute within the frame.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Locates elements containing specific text within the frame.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Locates elements by their title attribute within the frame.

methods.name: owner
methods.description: Returns the Locator object representing the iframe element itself, facilitating interactions with the iframe DOM element.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Creates a Locator within the context of the iframe, allowing element selection inside the iframe.
